description: Short and long replies: per-tag decode errors.

vectors.description: A short reply fails only the tags past its end.

F.v: 400002 (float32): short reply: need registers up to offset 2, got 2

vectors.description: An empty reply fails every tag.

A.v: 400001 (uint16): short reply: need registers up to offset 0, got 0

B.v: 400002 (uint16): short reply: need registers up to offset 1, got 0

vectors.description: A reply of exactly the block length decodes everything.
Extra registers after the block are ignored.
A string past the end of a short reply fails.

S.v: 400002.006H (string): short reply: need registers up to offset 3, got 2

vectors.description: An array that does not fit a short reply fails as a whole.

ARR.v: 400001[4] (uint16): short reply: need registers up to offset 3, got 3

vectors.description: A short coil reply fails the coils past its end.

C9.v: 000009 (bool): short reply: need bits up to offset 8, got 1

vectors.description: Aliases of a failed item all get the same decode error.

A.v: 400002 (uint16): short reply: need registers up to offset 1, got 1

A2.v: 400002 (uint16): short reply: need registers up to offset 1, got 1
